events.verdict: Hauser (BOS) reaches in for the ball and makes illegal contact with Mitchell's (CLE) left arm after his gather, which alters his driving shot attempt.
Hunter (CLE) and Tatum (BOS) engage and disengage away from the ball and the contact is marginal.
Tatum (BOS) continues to reposition into Garland (CLE), delivering contact that displaces the defender as he attempts to defend around the pick.
Strus (CLE) firms up in a screening position in Brown's (BOS) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Hauser (BOS) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Mitchell (CLE) makes last contact with the ball prior to it coming down out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Boston.
Tatum (BOS) establishes himself in Garland's (CLE) path and marginal contact occurs as Garland moves to go under the pick and Tatum rolls towards the paint.
Hunter (CLE) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Garland (CLE) momentarily brings his right arm around Tatum's (BOS) arm and the marginal contact dissolves as Tatum disengages to pursue the loose ball opportunity.
Mitchell (CLE) establishes himself in a legal screening position in Brown's (BOS) path and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Hauser (BOS) legally contests Garland's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Garland (CLE) turns his body slightly as he attempts to bring himself alongside White's (BOS) path and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Strus (CLE) jumps from point A to point B into White (BOS), delivering contact in the air that affects White's driving shot attempt at the basket.
Garland (CLE) establishes the ball in the frontcourt prior to eight seconds elapsing after receiving the ball in the backcourt.
White (BOS) legally contests Garland's (CLE) driving shot attempt and the body contact after the release as both players return to the ground is marginal.
Horford's (BOS) left forearm comes out slightly as he elevates to contest Garland's (CLE) driving shot attempt and the contact after the release is marginal.
Tatum (BOS) brings his right hand to Mobley's (CLE) back as he jumps into the air in pursuit of the rebound and the contact during the play is marginal.
Hunter (CLE) legally contests Tatum's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
White (BOS) commits a take foul on Mitchell (CLE). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Mitchell (CLE) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
